density.$description: The cds size scale (radius, control heights, icon, pad-*, gap-*, avatar-*, checkbox, switch, panel, page header, rings) at comfortable density, the account's setting; $extensions.compact is the value when data-density is compact or unset. controlStep.$description: A control's size steps, set with data-step 1 to 5 (data-size xs, sm, lg map onto them): step-2 is the compact density, step-4 the comfortable one.

duration.$description: fast 60 ms (button press), snap 120 ms (most UI), base 200 ms, sheet 300 ms, slow 450 ms; the sidebar frame has its own fast and slow.

frame.$description: The sidebar frame's own geometry (row height, font, icon, slots, the 288 width, the 48 header) at the comfortable web density; $extensions.compact is the default without it.

tailwind.$description: The Tailwind v4 theme the utility classes read: a 4px spacing unit, the container widths (max-w-2xl is the 672 home composer, the transcript is 48rem) and the radius scale.
